title.en: Setting offsets and traversing a file

hook.en: A video player lets you skip to minute 10 without watching the first nine. tell() and seek() let a program jump around inside a file.
hook.kn: ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್ ನೇರವಾಗಿ 10ನೇ ನಿಮಿಷಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಲು ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. tell() ಮತ್ತು seek() ಕಡತದೊಳಗೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಜಿಗಿಯಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Create a file and traverse it line by line

narration.en: A video player lets you skip to minute 10 without watching the first nine. tell() and seek() let a program jump around inside a file.
narration.kn: ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್ ನೇರವಾಗಿ 10ನೇ ನಿಮಿಷಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಲು ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. tell() ಮತ್ತು seek() ಕಡತದೊಳಗೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಜಿಗಿಯಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Every read or write moves the file offset forward. tell() returns the current position as the number of bytes from the beginning. seek(offset, reference_point) moves it: reference_point 0 is the beginning (default), 1 the current position and 2 the end. In text mode Python 3 allows offsets only from the beginning (plus seek(0, 2) for the end); non-zero offsets from 1 or 2 need binary mode.

narration.en: Every read or write moves the file offset forward. tell() returns the current position as the number of bytes from the beginning. seek(offset, reference_point) moves it: reference_point 0 is the beginning (default), 1 the current position and 2 the end. In text mode Python 3 allows offsets only from the beginning (plus seek(0, 2) for the end); non-zero offsets from 1 or 2 need binary mode.
narration.kn: tell() ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಆರಂಭದಿಂದ ಬೈಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. seek(offset, reference_point) ಆಫ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: 0 ಆರಂಭ, 1 ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಸ್ಥಾನ, 2 ಕೊನೆ.

title.en: Creating and traversing a text file

body.en: To create a file, open it in 'w' mode and write lines taken from the user. To traverse it, open it in 'r' mode and loop over the lines with for line in f: or with readline() until it returns an empty string. Opening in 'w+' lets the same file object write, seek(0) back, and read.

points.en: for line in f: print(line, end="")

narration.en: To create a file, open it in 'w' mode and write lines taken from the user. To traverse it, open it in 'r' mode and loop over the lines with for line in f: or with readline() until it returns an empty string. Opening in 'w+' lets the same file object write, seek(0) back, and read.
narration.kn: ಕಡತ ರಚಿಸಲು 'w' ಮೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತೆರೆದು ಬರೆಯಿರಿ. ಸಂಚರಿಸಲು 'r' ಮೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತೆರೆದು ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ for ಲೂಪ್ ಬಳಸಿ. 'w+' ಮೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದು seek(0) ಮಾಡಿ ಓದಬಹುದು.

problem.en: Use one file object in 'w+' mode to write and then read back. Give the exact output.

narration.en: write() returns 18 characters, and the offset is now at the end. seek(0) brings it back so the loop can read each line.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two board and CUET pattern questions. Try them on your own before we discuss.

points.en: tell() gives the offset in bytes from the beginning.
Traverse a file with a for loop; use 'w+' and seek(0) to read back what you wrote.
points.kn: for ಲೂಪ್‌ನಿಂದ ಸಂಚರಿಸಿ; 'w+' ಮತ್ತು seek(0) ಬಳಸಿ ಬರೆದುದನ್ನು ಓದಿ.

homework.en: Write a program that takes five lines from the user, stores them in a file and then displays only the lines that start with a vowel.

narration.en: Recap. tell() gives the offset in bytes from the beginning. seek(offset, ref): 0 beginning, 1 current, 2 end. Traverse a file with a for loop; use 'w+' and seek(0) to read back what you wrote.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. tell() ಆರಂಭದಿಂದ ಬೈಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆಫ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. seek(offset, ref): 0 ಆರಂಭ, 1 ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ, 2 ಕೊನೆ. for ಲೂಪ್‌ನಿಂದ ಸಂಚರಿಸಿ; 'w+' ಮತ್ತು seek(0) ಬಳಸಿ ಬರೆದುದನ್ನು ಓದಿ.
